title: MasakhaNER 2.0: Africa-centric Transfer Learning for Named Entity Recognition

bias_targets.methodology: Linking named entities in the dataset to Wikidata IDs using mGenre and mapping them to their continent and country of origin to analyze the spatial representativeness and ensure adequate representation of the African continent.

Evaluating and comparing zero-shot cross-lingual transfer performance on Named Entity Recognition (NER) tasks to demonstrate the performance degradation when defaulting to English as a source language rather than using typologically and geographically proximate African languages.

Using ExplainaBoard to compare NER model F1 scores on zero-frequency entities (entities unseen in the training corpus) versus frequently occurring entities, as well as evaluating performance disparities across different entity lengths.
